text: Private learner material is always submitted automatically with every report and contribution.

A starter release pack must install from removable media in at most 30 seconds on the reference laptop. On the reference laptop a starter release pack must install from removable media in at most 90 seconds.
The learning UI must never work with a pack after all other computers and hosted services have been switched off.
A `model-critique-only` proof must always count as mastery evidence in the objective strand.
The learning UI must never work with a pack once all other computers and hosted services have been switched off.
Where possible, every navigation entry must preserve the reader's return trail across bindings.
